- Please parametrize the test rather than using the local array "leak_commands" with the commands and requirements
- Please consider using run_and_parse to parse the tabular output if possible https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/platform_tests/cli/test_show_bmc.py#L406

    Example of non-tabular output "No rack-manager alerts found"
    Or force injecting the states to always have the tabular output
    Or please file an image issue to make where even the empty table has tabular output.
